turns.query: Analyze pre-typhoon versus post-typhoon air quality patterns from 2025-07-19 to 2025-07-21 period. Calculate pollution clearance effectiveness of tropical cyclone systems and determine optimal timing for outdoor activities following storm passages.
turns.actual_response:
The analysis of pre-typhoon versus post-typhoon air quality patterns from 2025-07-19 to 2025-07-21 shows the following results:

- **Network-wide mean PM2.5 on 2025-07-19 (pre-typhoon):** 19.01 μg/m³
- **Network-wide mean AQHI on 2025-07-19 (pre-typhoon):** 3.35
- **Network-wide mean PM2.5 on 2025-07-21 (post-typhoon):** 7.31 μg/m³
- **Network-wide mean AQHI on 2025-07-21 (post-typhoon):** 2.76
- **PM2.5 clearance (pre minus post network mean PM2.5):** 11.70 μg/m³

The significant reduction in PM2.5 levels from 19.01 μg/m³ to 7.31 μg/m³, a clearance of 11.70 μg/m³, indicates the effectiveness of the tropical cyclone system in clearing air pollution. This suggests that the optimal timing for outdoor activities following a storm passage is around 2 days post-typhoon, when the air quality has significantly improved.
